data.summary: The factory-run `npm test` (exit 0, 57/57 pass) and `npm run build` (exit 0) are green, and no existing test was touched. The change still fails acceptance criterion 5: the Summary Profit KPI renders the percentage unmasked when privacy mode is on, because `isPrivate` is never applied to that value in `Summary.jsx`. The remaining UI criteria (header/ThemeToggle, no-flash script, skeleton, BaseModal props and behaviour) were checked by static reading only, since no browser or dev server was available to me.

bugReports.title: Summary Profit KPI is not masked in privacy mode
stepsToReproduce: Run the UI in ui/ with `npm run dev` (or `npm run build` and serve ui/dist).
Open /invest-track/ and click the eye toggle so privacy mode is on (localStorage privacyMode='true').
Look at the Summary section, Total row, Profit card, and expand Organic Details.
bugReports.expected: Every value in the Summary KPI cards is masked when privacy mode is on, per acceptance criterion 5. The profit percentage is masked the same way as the currency values.
bugReports.actual: Invested, Obtained and Benefit are masked through formatValueForPrivacy, but the Profit value is `${(100 * profit).toFixed(2)}%` (ui/src/components/investments/Summary.jsx line 62), which ignores isPrivate. The real profit percentage is shown in privacy mode, in both the total and the organic rows.
bugReports.evidence: ui/src/components/investments/Summary.jsx:62 `value={`${(100 * profit).toFixed(2)}%`}` has no isPrivate branch. SummaryRow receives isPrivate (line 87, 111) but the Profit KPI never uses it. Acceptance criterion 5 states values are masked when privacy mode is on.

data.recommendation: In ui/src/components/investments/Summary.jsx, make the Profit KPI honour privacy mode. In SummaryRow, compute the profit display as `isPrivate ? <the same masked placeholder that formatValueForPrivacy returns> : `${(100 * profit).toFixed(2)}%``, or add a small formatPercentForPrivacy helper next to formatValueForPrivacy in ui/src/lib/currencyAdapter.js. Do not change the chart or service files to do this. Keep signClass on the masked value as well. Then re-run `npm test` and `npm run build` in ui/ and verify in a browser that privacy mode hides the Profit value in both the total and the organic rows. Optionally add a regression test if a pure helper is extracted.
